propositions: Any single project's transport failure (400/401/403/404/429/5xx/timeout) in the base-query loop currently aborts the entire reconcile pass for all projects, causing widespread outage.
The base-query loop lacks per-project error isolation that exists in the enrichment loop (_enrich_project already fails open independently).
A syntactically-valid but nonexistent project key triggers ACLI failure and cascades to disable all scheduled reconcile passes, as occurred in the 2026-08-15 production incident.
Per-project fetch failures must emit observable `fetcher-project-fetch-failed` alerts naming the project and pass_id, while continuing to process other projects.

Invalid/absent project keys must still fail closed (preserving bug 626d intent) and `BackendPaginationStallError` must re-raise, but recoverable transport errors must not abort the pass or merge partial results.
